status: CPU reference and interface design complete; serving adaptation not integrated or benchmarked
candidate: Retain unchanged Week 4 LARB controller and 5C evidence
method_name: LASER-informed ATP replay adaptation (provisional); not a faithful full-system reproduction

capacity_variant.status: proposed capacity adaptation, not outcome-tuned or frozen for 6C

parameters.reset: one global EMA initialized to zero for each drained policy phase; one ordered update per ATP evaluation, not per decoded token or per auxiliary sequence

atp.primary: DEER(W): case-sensitive decoded stop string Wait; no union with Alternatively, no entropy detector
atp.token_boundary: Backend must align the first complete marker to token IDs, handle split stream chunks, suppress duplicate detection, and preserve the original token prefix; not implemented in a serving backend
atp.probe_prefix: Snapshot before ATP marker plus inducer; rejected probe restores the exact original token IDs including marker. Accepted probe transitions from the checkpoint to finalization. Any discarded suffix is charged.
atp.cadence: At ATPs only; no fixed token interval disguised as an ATP
atp.fallback: No marker: ordinary reasoning until natural close or common hard cap; log absence

confidence.definition: exp(mean(raw top-1 log probability per scored position))
confidence.provenance: DEER Eq.4 supplies a concrete option absent from LASER details; it is a declared inherited/adapted choice
confidence.sampling: Proposed probes: temperature=0, top_p=1, top_k=-1, logprobs=1; unmodified parent sampling remains 0.6/0.95/20. Record raw_logprobs mode.
confidence.mask: All newly generated trial tokens including braces/formatting except terminal EOS/think-close; no prompt tokens. Different masking from public helper is explicit.
confidence.validity: Complete nonempty balanced boxed trial answer, normal terminal result, aligned token/logprob lengths; length cap, missing rank1, malformed/nonfinite data produce no confidence exit.
confidence.comparison: Strict score > threshold; equality continues; confidence estimates self-certainty rather than correctness
confidence.consistency: No Dynasor sliding stability window or reference-answer access; contradictory high-confidence probes are possible and are not hidden

limits.status: draft safety envelope; not an authorized GPU configuration
limits.budget_units: variable-length ATP chunks; no fixed chunk-to-token conversion; independent token safety cap, cue, and answer reserve
limits.paper_difference: LASER setup uses total generation 16384 and Qwen think_ratio .8; matching our existing caps is a disclosed adaptation

early_exit.positive: Complete cue/think-close then regenerate final answer from retained reasoning; trial answer is not a scored final
early_exit.negative: Discard all probe tokens and continue exact saved reasoning prefix; a new request ID/RNG stream cannot preserve the original ongoing RNG state through replay
early_exit.budget: Final allowed chunk still pays its probe before forced finalization, unless natural closure or hard token safety cap takes precedence
early_exit.identity: phase/parent/probe sequence + immutable prefix identity; late/foreign/cancelled results rejected; drain before phase changes

runtime.available: AsyncLLM.generate, abort, token prompts, logprobs=1, public request IDs
runtime.missing: No public per-request KV fork/pause/resume in inspected AsyncLLM; global sleep is not a request-level branch interface
runtime.preferred_eventual_backend: Native per-request checkpoint/fork and rollback with bounded memory, auxiliary calls charged to shared capacity; new runtime engineering and gate needed
runtime.bounded_prototype: Serial stop/resubmit with exact token-ID replay through the same engine; cache off initial diagnostic, no hidden second engine. It pays recomputation and changes scheduling/RNG, so report as an adaptation.
runtime.scheduling_gate: All auxiliary calls obey global max_num_seqs=2 and stock scheduling. Never run engine calls in the logits processor. No waiting parent may hold a semaphore that a child probe needs. Measure re-entry order and active count semantics before comparison.
runtime.load_gate: Paper active count excludes auxiliary probes and waiting requests. A replay backend must define/check logical versus physical active count; cannot silently count probes as load or substitute queue length.
runtime.cache: Prefix cache is not branch rollback or RNG restore. If enabled, rerun all arms under the same setting and reset/drain phases; report computed prefill and cache occupancy, not just submitted prefix length.

costs.end_to_end: Client scheduled-arrival to final terminal receipt includes queue, every probe, replay, transition, final answer, and drain; summed call time is not parallel wall latency.
costs.computation: Report main/auxiliary tokens and actual computed prefill separately; include repeated prefixes, discarded trial output, cancellation tail, and calibration. FLOPs require a declared model estimator, not a claim that each token costs equally.
costs.failure_policy: Invalid/missing counters fail the cost-complete gate; cap/error outcomes stay in denominator; no free retries or accuracy-conditioned replacement

calibration.allowed_indices: 0–99 only; no dataset examples generated in 6B
calibration.forbidden: No tuning on the 24 consumed 5B questions; preserve remaining 376 provisionally unused
calibration.comparison: Fresh matched cache/runtime campaign; never pool baseline numbers with old cache-disabled LARB results
